future_approval_prerequisites.description: Independently establish exact isolated test DB host and network route; not Node B by assumption
Exact new disposable isolated database identity; no protected fixture, restore, shared staging or production database
Least-privilege actor and schema-specific CREATE/READ/WRITE capabilities separately approved
Exact noncertified isolated runtime checkout with source HEAD and nonproduction config
Evidence network/credentials cannot reach production or protected databases
Dedicated synthetic tenant, farm/cycle/actor permission and cross-tenant denial matrix
Exact schema version, eligible PHP runtime and source SHA integrity proof
Dated layer/broiler/ruminant V3 baselines and planned movement sources
Actual synthetic daily row IDs and matching projection source IDs, not guessed
Explicit approval to create minimal isolated test records and transaction writes
Verified test-only rollback/reseed or approved encrypted backup evidence; no protected restore
Planned rollback and replay/idempotence checks without leaving durable damage
Expected ledger movement, daily stock, Feed, egg-sale and mortality reconciliation
Named operator, explicit execution window, abort conditions, stop and containment procedure
No production API keys, mail, payments, cron, session secrets or monitoring callbacks
Separate written user authorization naming actual host, DB, tenant, commands and allowed writes

future_runtime_test_cases.title: canonical_layer_opening
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: V3 layer baseline, saved Daily Record source ID and pending mortality
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Canonical snapshot selected; later openings rebased; original mortality unchanged

future_runtime_test_cases.title: broiler_mixed_exits
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: V3 Broiler baseline with dated Sale, Slaughter and Transfer movements
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Later opening and closing derive from canonical physical movement order without double-counting

future_runtime_test_cases.title: ruminant_species_scope
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: Ruminant cycle with multiple animal_type rows; saved source identity
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Only the intended species' later Daily Records are corrected

future_runtime_test_cases.title: legacy_preview_fallback
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: Legacy cycle without canonical V3 baseline and preview call omitting source ID
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Legacy opening chain remains compatible; no unintended canonical write

future_runtime_test_cases.title: layer_eggs_revenue
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: Layer later-date eggs, historical egg allocation and corrected opening
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Eggs cannot exceed opening, laying rate recalculates, egg-sales allocation conserves pool

future_runtime_test_cases.title: invalid_future_mortality
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: Later daily mortality exceeds corrected canonical opening
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Explicit rejection; single transaction rolls back all daily/feed/mortality/allocations

future_runtime_test_cases.title: negative_canonical_balance
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: Historical physical movement would yield a negative later population
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Boundary guard blocks; no persisted negative population and no partially committed source

future_runtime_test_cases.title: mortality_replay_reversal
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: Same Daily Record mortality corrected repeatedly and replayed
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Versioned source projection/reversal idempotence, no duplicated physical reductions

future_runtime_test_cases.title: feed_and_stock_atomicity
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: Daily feed usage and stock item with receipts/valuations
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Linked USED/reversal source ownership intact; failed transaction reverses no stock without counterpart

future_runtime_test_cases.title: tenant_role_and_csrf
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: Two unrelated synthetic tenant farms, actors, cycles, records and role boundaries
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Unauthorized cross-farm, wrong-role and CSRF operations denied without data alteration

future_runtime_test_cases.title: rollback_at_mid_writer
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: Controlled failure between continuity, feed, mortality and Layer egg-sales rebuild
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Entire caller-owned transaction rolled back; all ledgers unchanged

future_runtime_test_cases.title: concurrent_correction_locks
future_runtime_test_cases.preconditions: Two isolated concurrent edits targeting one cycle/date
future_runtime_test_cases.assertion: Consistent lock order, one authoritative result or safe conflict, no silent overwrite
